orb2diabat.help: Writes BSE excitations for Diabat 2.0: an fchk with the BSE orbitals (mofile) and Diabat's native electronic-state file (statefile).

job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for intermediate files

spin.help: BSE spin type(s) to write; one statefile per type

nstates.help: Number of lowest states to write, 0 writes all stored states
